# Merge reviewers: accounts that send other people's pull requests to the merge queue with a `/merge` comment, with
# no repository role (docs/release-flow.md "Merge reviewers", tools/ci/merge_command.py).
# One line per reviewer:
#
#   <numeric GitHub ID> <login> until <YYYY-MM-DD> </folder/> [</folder/> ...]   # who added it and when
#
# - The ID decides; the login is for people reading this file. Get it with `gh api users/<login> --jq .id`.
# - `until` is the last day (UTC) the line works. It can be at most 31 days away: a later date grants nothing until
#   it is that close, so staying a merge reviewer takes a new date every month. Extend a line by changing its date.
# - The folders are the only places a pull request may change for this reviewer's `/merge` to work, written from
#   the repository's root: `/crates/horizon-world/` is that folder and all below it, `/tools/test_*_parity.py`
#   those files (`*` stays inside one name; no `**`). What CODEOWNERS guards is never included, whatever is
#   written here.
# A line in any other form grants nothing. Removing a line revokes that account at once. A line with only `paused`
# stops `/merge` for everyone listed.
